title: Tropical Reinforcement Learning
author: [[Arip Asadulaev, Aladin Djuhera, Karim Salta, Holger Boche, Fakhri Karray, Martin Takac]]
description: arXiv:2610.02478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models typically maximizes expected return, adding up the probabilities of all successful trajectories. However, the classical sum formulation can only report how often the model policy succeeds, not which solution actually worked, and because probabilities sum to one, reinforcing one solution can make the model forget another that was never shown to be wrong. This makes expected return a poor fit for compositional reasoning, where a solution must be assembled from reasoning steps that the model produces in separate, often failed, attempts but rarely produces together. To address this, we propose Tropical Reinforcement Learning, which rests on a simple change of algebra: instead of adding the probabilities of alternative solutions, we take their maximum, which yields the tropical semiring. The value of a state then becomes the log-probability of its most likely verified solution, together with an explicit path that can be replayed and reused. This enables true composition, since the best prefix and the best suffix meeting at a shared state can be joined even when they come from different rollouts. To put this into practice, we introduce TROPIC, a training algorithm for deterministic, resettable environments with verifiable outcomes. On four agentic tasks (Sokoban, Countdown, FrozenLake, WebShop), TROPIC outperforms the strongest on-policy baselines by up to 16 percentage points. Changing the algebra of reinforcement learning, not just its estimators, can thus substantially improve compositional reasoning in language models

title: MEA: A Reward-Driven Multi-Agent System for Faithful Model Explanations
author: [[Yuyang Cheng, Raghav Kaushik Ravi, Srivarshinee Sridhar, Sriparna Saha, Akash Ghosh, Chirag Agarwal]]
description: arXiv:2610.02480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent years have seen the employment of a plethora of machine learning (ML) models in high-stakes domains, but they remain largely opaque to the practitioners who act on their predictions. While post-hoc explanation methods offer a lens into this model behavior, wielding them effectively demands expertise most domain experts lack: navigating high-dimensional outputs, selecting the best explanations, and synthesizing evidence across disparate tools. To this end, we present MEA, a multi-agent framework that removes the explanation knowledge barrier entirely: a Proposer agent selects and configures explanation tools based on the question and modality, while an Actor agent is optimized end-to-end against faithfulness, transforming the outputs into natural language explanations grounded in model behavior across tabular, text, and vision modalities. Further, we introduce diverse question types spanning feature attribution, counterfactual reasoning, and spurious feature detection, each paired with a perturbation-based faithfulness metric. We find that frontier LLMs systematically produce unfaithful explanations. By optimizing against faithfulness rewards augmented with a modality-adaptive penalty, MEA consistently outperforms post hoc explainers, agentic, and closed-source baselines across six datasets, with reward-driven optimization yielding faithfulness gains of +28% (tabular), +21% (text), and +34% (vision) over the untrained backbone. More broadly, our findings suggest that AI agents themselves can serve as a scalable, adaptable interface to ML explainability, opening a path toward natural-language explainability that generalizes beyond the fixed, single-purpose tools that have long defined the field.

title: DeReAct: Decomposed Reasoning and Acting for Reliable AI Agents
author: [[Ajay Vohra, Tao Chen, Neeti Narayan, Caron Zhang]]
description: arXiv:2610.02351v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: ReAct-based agents typically rely on a single LLM policy to propose actions, interact with the environment, and decide when a task is complete. This coupling makes action authorization and completion control difficult to enforce independently, allowing errors to propagate and unsupported completion claims to terminate execution. We introduce DeReAct, a modular agent architecture that externalizes two gating policies: a Critic that validates proposed actions before execution, and a Context Manager that reconstructs an environment-supported \textsc{State} and certifies task completion. Across GAIA and SWE-bench Verified, DeReAct improves Pass@1 most for weaker Brain models, with gains of 6.5--7.0 points for Qwen3-Coder-480B and 4.2--5.2 points for Claude Sonnet~4.5; gains diminish as Brain capability increases. Trajectory and ablation analyses show that external gating is effective when targeted failures are sufficiently prevalent and the gating policy is itself sufficient. With Claude Opus~4.5, Pass@1 remains comparable to ReAct, while DeReAct produces more evidence-complete and constraint-satisfying trajectories, indicating that completion control can trade earlier termination for stronger grounding. Overall, DeReAct improves weaker agents while retaining grounding benefits as models strengthen.

title: THPL: A Vision-to-Language Decision Support Framework for Rainbow Trout Feeding Management in RAS
author: [[Meng Liang, Guanbo Feng, Haozhuang Chi, Shilong Zhao, Zhixin Xiong, Yuhang He, Wenfeng Han, Tianhao Zhao, Zhihong Ma, Ying Liu]]
description: arXiv:2610.02378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS), precision feeding is critical for minimizing costs and improving fish welfare. However, existing methods lack cognitive alignment between fish behaviors and management knowledge, impeding translation into executable, interpretable feeding decisions. To address this, we propose THPL, a generative feeding decision framework tailored for rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) in RAS. First, Fishsort extracts trajectories to establish an Activity Coefficient (AC) quantifying feeding intensity. Second, a Hierarchical Behavior Encoder (HBE) models individual temporal progression and collective dynamics using Temporal and Set Transformers, transforming trajectory tensors into dual-evidence representations of explicit physical and implicit soft tokens. Finally, these tokens are integrated with environmental parameters, metadata, and expert rules to fine-tune an LLM via LoRA, followed by counterfactual multimodal Direct Preference Optimization (mDPO) to reinforce causal reasoning. Results show that AC exhibits a statistically significant monotonic positive correlation with expert-annotated feeding intensity (Spearman $\rho = 0.925$, $p < 0.001$). Ablations indicate that decision accuracy improves from 33.33% (text-only baseline) to 93.33% with dual-evidence tokens, confirming that continuous spatiotemporal tokens provide necessary physical grounding for LLMs. Compared with standard LoRA, counterfactual mDPO elevates decision accuracy from 93.33% to 96.67%, advances METEOR from 58.10% to 85.30%, reduces Self-BLEU-2 from 58.79% to 52.88%, and increases Distinct-3 from 6.68% to 7.81%, suppressing templating and actuation biases while reinforcing causal consistency and operational safety. Overall, by integrating continuous kinematics with LLM reasoning, this study provides a novel decision support paradigm for precision aquaculture.

title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
author: [[Jiawei Li]]
description: arXiv:2610.02267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. We present a paired evaluation of an open-weight (Laya) and a hosted (Jev) System-1 model on 11 agent decision points built from 18 public sources: 7,283 base cases plus 6,640 robustness variants, with byte-identical inputs, paired tests, and cross-hardware and cross-day reproducibility checks. Jev is significantly more accurate on 9 of 11 decision points (+10.8 to +46.0 pp). Neither model beats chance on zero-shot model routing, and they tie on RAG relevance gating. Laya changes 30% of its answers when the option order is reversed and degrades sharply with many or similar candidates (31% at 50 nearest-neighbour tools, vs. 98% for Jev on items with a unique correct tool). We also audit our own pipeline. Three analysis errors and one design confound distorted headline deployment claims: an omitted pre-screen cost (reported 23.9% saving, actual 4.3%), gate accuracy reported as end-to-end quality (58% vs. 98%), in-sample thresholds (5% target, up to 17% held-out misses), and a "channel effect" on injection false positives that vanishes with channel-native content. Two other suspected confounds did not change the conclusions. All cases, raw outputs and analysis code are available at https://github.com/David-DL-Space/sys1-eval.

title: Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
author: [[Yu Li, Zheng Zhang, Xin Liu, Shengtian Yang, Guangfeng Cai, Lei Feng]]
description: arXiv:2610.02330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate the downstream effect of an intermediate decision. In this paper, we argue that effective tool-use agents should estimate the long-horizon value of a possible next tool invocation before executing it. This objective requires comparative supervision over alternative invocations under the same context, while logged trajectories only contain the invocation that was actually taken. Therefore, we propose Comparative Inference for Tool-use Agents (CITA). CITA trains a Comparative Inference Model (CIM) from paired signals that combine observed tool behavior, scalable supervision from a Bayesian tool-graph simulator, and semantic judgments from LLM-based comparison. The resulting CIM learns to estimate how likely a possible next tool invocation is to support final task success under the current context. Across three tool-use benchmarks and multiple backbone LLMs, CITA consistently improves Tool F1 and task success. Additional analysis shows that CIM learns accurate step-level value estimates for comparative tool choices.

title: When Terminal-Agent Training Stalls: Demystifying Data Generation and Verification Challenge
author: [[Xi Qin, Isabel Kurth, Xin Cui, Elin Park, Alexander Schaefer, Yaad Oren]]
description: arXiv:2610.02405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using a frontier model like Claude Opus as a meta-agent to generate terminal tasks and verifiers for RL training is increasingly common. Yet a runnable Docker image and executable test suite do not guarantee a faithful end-to-end pipeline for terminal agent training. We present a meta-agent pipeline motivated by this gap, diagnosing three classes of failure: benchmark invalidity, harness brittleness, and reward misalignment. Prompt redesign and context extension raise baseline solvability 5.6 times, but a 9B model saturates at 81.3% mean pass@2 within 20 steps on Claude Opus-generated tasks. Adding hard tasks reduces mean pass@2 to 20.6% without changing the training configuration, a strong evidence that the solvability band is model-specific. These findings demonstrate that meta-agent reliability requires solvability-band calibration, verifier audits, and infrastructure error accounting as first-class evaluation criteria, not post-hoc diagnost.

title: Right Order, Wrong Scale: Auditing LLM Judges for Occupational AI Measurement
author: [[Harry Lyu, Neil Thompson]]
description: arXiv:2610.02492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM judges are increasingly used to assess whether AI outputs meet workplace requirements, but agreement on response rankings does not establish agreement on acceptance rates or occupational aggregates. We introduce O*NET-BENCH, an audit suite derived from an existing survey of 45,796 worker ratings, and evaluate 33 pre-existing judge configurations across six model families on 4,501 test ratings. Twenty-five configurations achieve tie-aware pair accuracy of at least 0.60, although a train-fitted response-only TF-IDF baseline nearly matches the strongest judge. Despite this ordering agreement, judges estimate that 3.0%-97.9% of responses are acceptable, compared with 61.1% for occupation-matched workers. In one fine-tuned lineage, changing from pointwise scoring to a bundled few-shot/listwise protocol improves response ordering while reducing agreement with worker means at the task and occupation levels; this reversal replicates on a task- and worker-disjoint validation split under prespecified criteria. Cross-validated calibration largely removes mean bias, but calibrated scores explain at most 8.5% of individual worker-rating variance. Prediction-assisted estimation yields at most small precision gains at the studied label budgets. These results show that ranking agreement alone is insufficient for occupational measurement. Judges should be validated against the acceptance rates and aggregates their scores will be used to estimate.

title: Reinforcement Learning Techniques for the Optimization of Target Polarization in Nuclear Physics Scattering Experiments
author: [[Armen Kasparian, Torri Jeske, Monibor Rahman, Chris Keith, James Maxwell, Thomas Britton, Malachi Schram, David Lawrence]]
description: arXiv:2610.02452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The operation of dynamically polarized targets in nuclear physics experiments relies on continuous tuning of the microwave frequency to compensate for radiation damage and evolving material properties, a task that is traditionally performed through manual trial-and-error by expert operators. This work presents a data-driven control framework that combines surrogate modeling with reinforcement learning to optimize the target polarization. Using operational data from the APOLLO cryogenic target system, we train and evaluate multilayer perceptron and Gaussian process regression models to predict polarization as a function of microwave frequency, beam current, and accumulated radiation dose. We show that Gaussian process-based models provide calibrated uncertainty estimates and reliably identify regions outside the training distribution, while MLPs exhibit limited sensitivity to distributional shift. To enable learning and control across multiple target samples, we introduce a Gaussian process approximation and embed the surrogate model within a standardized simulation environment. A reinforcement learning agent is trained using a lower-confidence-bound reward formulation that balances performance maximization against uncertainty. We are able to show an almost 2x improvement on the operators actions utilizing our RL agent.

title: Traversing the Satisfaction-Diversity Frontier in Text-to-Image Diffusion
author: [[Kevin Zhai, Siva Rajesh Kasa, Soumya Roy, Sumit Negi, Mubarak Shah]]
description: arXiv:2610.02372v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Text-to-image generation enables users to explore several images generated from the same prompt. For these generated images to be useful, each one must reflect the user's preferences, measured by a learned reward, and differ visually from the others to maintain diversity. Existing methods are limited: they either address reward and diversity separately or combine them in one aggregate score, enabling high diversity to offset low rewards. In this paper, we address these limitations by formulating generation as satisficing: every image (candidate) must satisfy a reward floor and the batch of images must satisfy a diversity cutoff. The reward floor controls the balance between worst-candidate reward and batch diversity; we show that varying this floor defines a Pareto frontier. To traverse this frontier, we introduce SatisDive, a training-free inference-time method. SatisDive uses a batch-relative reward cutoff to distinguish lower- from higher-reward candidates, emphasizing reward improvement for candidates below the cutoff and diversity among candidates above it. On Pick-a-Pic, at matched DreamSim, SatisDive improves worst-candidate reward over FK steering by up to 0.43 with FLUX.1-dev as the base model and HPSv3 as the reward, and by up to 0.70 with SANA-1.6B as the base model and ImageReward as the reward. More broadly, across their overlapping DreamSim ranges, SatisDive's satisfaction-diversity curve Pareto-dominates FK steering's curve in each setting.

title: What Does a Token Cost? A Mixture-of-Agents Measurement of Sufficient Per-Token Compute
author: [[Zhixu Du, Weijia Han, Hai Helen Li, Yiran Chen]]
description: arXiv:2610.02491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models spend the same amount of computation on every token they generate, regardless of how difficult each token is to produce. Methods such as speculative decoding and model routing are built on the premise that much of this computation is unnecessary, yet the computation an individual token actually requires has not been measured. We measure it through a Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) lens: a panel of fifteen language models of increasing capacity, drawn from three families, in which every agent attempts to reproduce a reference sequence token by token, conditioned on the correct preceding tokens. We define the inference cost of the smallest agent that succeeds as the token's sufficient compute, which upper-bounds what the token requires. On three core benchmarks, a 0.5B agent reproduces 92--95\% of reference tokens. Across Qwen, OLMo, and R1-distilled panels, the most expensive 10\% account for 64--80\% of estimated FLOPs. On all 500 MATH-500 problems, the MoA-derived map helps model routing reduce projected latency from 7.59 to 5.12 seconds while slightly improving accuracy, relative to the best confidence-routing baseline. The MoA-map helps drafting use 32.6\% fewer draft tokens and approximately 20\% lower projected latency than fixed-window drafting at similar accuracy. These comparisons reveal remaining allocation headroom, motivating controllers that exploit sufficient-compute structure.

title: FlashSinkhorn 2: Block-Sparse Entropic Optimal Transport
author: [[Felix X. -F. Ye, Yu Chin Fabian Lim, Naigang Wang, Davis Wertheimer]]
description: arXiv:2610.02395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Streaming GPU solvers for entropic optimal transport (EOT), such as FlashSinkhorn, avoid storing the dense kernel but still evaluate all $n\times m$ point pairs in every Sinkhorn iteration. We present \textbf{FlashSinkhorn~2} (FS2), a solver for squared-Euclidean cost on low-dimensional point clouds that solves large discrete EOT problems to a prescribed marginal residual on a single GPU by coupling two stages. A coarse stage solves on cell centroids, lifts the potentials to every point and, when a sampled marginal check rejects the lift, continues on the centroids, replacing most point-level updates. A block-sparse fine stage then removes the centroid error that coarse updates cannot. Its Morton-ordered blocks support screening and fused tensor-core execution, and a threshold set by the block masses bounds each omitted tile's contribution to every row and column. On synthetic benchmarks, FS2 reaches the target residual on all 32 problems and GeomLoss multiscale on 10. On one A100, FS2 solves discrete EOT between two $1.34\times10^8$-particle measures from a cosmological $N$-body simulation, at an entropic blur equal to the mean interparticle distance, to an all-particle marginal residual below 0.01 in under 2.5 hours. To our knowledge, it is the largest discrete EOT problem solved to this accuracy within hours. For reproducibility, we release an open-source implementation at https://github.com/ot-triton-lab/flash-sinkhorn

title: On-Premises Multi-Course RAG Tutoring for Business Education: Hardware-Software Trade-offs in a Campus AI Tutor
author: [[Sidney Shapiro, Joshua Lindemann]]
description: arXiv:2610.02510v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Campus AI tutors based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must ground answers in assigned course materials while keeping textbooks and student dialogue on institutional infrastructure. We present CourseChat, an on-premises, multi-course RAG tutor for undergraduate business education, deployed behind a campus web gateway and intended for use embedded in Moodle. Six isolated course offerings, each keyed by its own course reference number (CRN), share twin-edge AI hosts running a FastAPI service, a local vector database, and a local large language model (LLM) served by Ollama. We report two generation-model bake-off rounds, a separate fixed-evidence source-fidelity comparison, and conversation and quiz audits. Several larger models failed the classroom speed gate, but a 12B model and a 7B alternative passed. A separate mixture-of-experts candidate improved some corrections while introducing new factual and continuity errors. We therefore retain the 8B production model pending a demonstrated overall improvement, rather than claiming that 8B is universally optimal. Software changes improved follow-up topic resolution while preserving course scope; 435 prebuilt questions across 65 modules decouple practice from live generation. The results support treating model choice, evidence selection, serving compatibility, and product design as a joint engineering decision. They do not establish learning gains: faculty ratings, peak-load capacity, and complete public-gateway acceptance remain separate evaluation needs.

title: World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth
author: [[Max Ku, Nok-Kan Law, Yu-Chien Tang, Shih-Ying Yeh, Ping Nie, Andy Zheng, Tat Hei Lai, Fei-Yueh Chen, Nikko Yu, Wei-Chieh Sun, Suzy Huang, Chiao-Wei Hsu, Chih-Chuan Huang, Chak-Wing Mak, Ho Yin Sam Ng, Edisy Kin Wai Chan, Min-Hung Chen, Ho Kei Cheng]]
description: arXiv:2610.02331v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. We instantiate this capability through industry-grade game modding and introduce IGMWorld, together with IGMBench, a benchmark of 110 tasks and over 1.1K executable state and behavioral criteria across Minecraft and Terraria. The tasks span property, entity, dynamics, and system interventions and are evaluated through deterministic executability, behavioral, preservation, and visual checks. Frontier coding agents already exhibit substantial world-editing capability: the strongest configuration solves 78.2% of tasks under a strict task-level criterion, while criterion-level performance reaches 94.8%. Reliability generally decreases with intervention depth, and this pattern persists even among tasks with similar numbers of evaluation criteria. Most failed edits still build and load successfully, suggesting that the main difficulty is making the edited world behave as requested. Visual consistency remains a separate weakness, with all evaluated configurations below 50% joint visual pass rate. These results show that world editing is a distinct capability from world generation and interaction, and that executable games provide a practical testbed for studying it.

title: World Action Modeling with Progressive Visual Planning
author: [[Fei Zhang, Zhaochong An, Duncan Frost, Yikai Wang, Pengfei Liu, Ya Zhang, Michal Drozdzal, Amir Bar]]
description: arXiv:2610.02508v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual dynamics and actions from an initial observation and instruction. However, existing WAMs struggle with long-horizon prediction, as generating dense video rollouts is highly inefficient. Some recent WAMs address this by predicting a single future frame without generating the full video, but this approach neglects how to progress toward the goal. We present ProWAM, a progressive world action model that jointly predicts actions and an ordered sequence of sparse visual sub-goals, providing explicit visual guidance to anchor action generation throughout task execution. This design scales naturally, as sub-goal prediction can be learned from large-scale action-free videos, allowing the video backbone to offload complex visual planning from the action policy. For efficient action generation, ProWAM executes a single video-backbone forward pass to cache sparse sub-goal features, eliminating iterative full-video generation and requiring only lightweight action denoising during replanning. Across extensive evaluations, ProWAM achieves superior out-of-distribution robustness. On simulation benchmarks, it sets new state-of-the-art results on LIBERO-Plus (85.8%) and randomized RoboTwin (75.7%), outperforming the strongest baseline with relative gains of up to +35.9%. On RoboCasa365, ProWAM achieves a 48.1% success rate and 18.2% on the challenging Composite-Unseen split, ranking 4th overall. Crucially, in zero-shot real-world experiments, ProWAM achieves 70.0% success, outperforming the strongest baseline by +15.0 (from 55.0% to 70.0%, a +27.3% relative gain) in novel scenes. These results demonstrate the value of progress-indexed visual foresight for closed-loop control. Our program is in https://sii-ferenas.github.io/ProWAM-page.

title: Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization
author: [[Hangzhan jin, Mohammad Hamdaqa, Doina Precup]]
description: arXiv:2610.04011v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves reasoning, while the allocation of learning signal shapes which solutions remain accessible under repeated sampling. Group-relative objectives assign equal advantages to equally rewarded responses, making aggregate credit proportional to sampled mode frequency. We introduce Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization (ExPPO), a lightweight advantage-shaping rule that redistributes credit using prompt-relative, length-normalized response surprisal and prompt pass rate. ExPPO combines bounded shaping with shared normalization to preserve verifier polarity and approximately maintain each prompt group's total absolute sequence-advantage mass. Our analysis characterizes response-level credit allocation alongside sampled mode updates, deriving local conditions for gains in entropy and correct-mode discovery. Experiments show improved in-domain and out-of-domain reasoning coverage, higher aggregate response accuracy, and strong coverage at large sampling budgets. A controlled multi-answer evaluation further demonstrates increased correct-mode yield and gains in diversity among verified-correct responses. Code is available at https://github.com/jinhangzhan/ExPPO
tldr: 论文提出 Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization（ExPPO），一种轻量级优势塑形规则，通过基于提示相对、长度归一化的响应意外度与提示通过率重新分配信用，以在重复采样下保留可发现性。实验显示该方法在同域与跨域推理覆盖、聚合准确率及大采样预算下的覆盖度上均有提升。
objective_summary: arXiv 论文《Exploration-Preserving Policy Optimization》提出 ExPPO，针对带可验证奖励的强化学习在推理任务中学习信号分配不均的问题。作者指出组相对目标会给同等奖励的响应分配相同优势，使聚合信用与采样模式频率成比例。ExPPO 利用提示相对、长度归一化的响应意外度与提示通过率重分配信用，通过有界塑形与共享归一化保持验证器极性，并近似维持每个提示组的总绝对序列优势质量。分析刻画了响应级信用分配与采样模式更新，推导出熵增益与正确模式发现的局部条件。实验表明同域与跨域推理覆盖提升、聚合响应准确率更高、大采样预算下覆盖度强，多答案受控评测显示正确模式产出与已验证正确响应的多样性均有增益，代码已公开。

组相对目标会给获得同等奖励的响应分配相同优势，导致聚合信用与采样到的模式频率成正比。

ExPPO 通过有界塑形与共享归一化，保持验证器的极性，并近似维持每个提示组的总绝对序列优势质量。
理论分析同时刻画了响应级信用分配与采样模式更新，并推导出熵增益和正确模式发现的局部条件。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 核心创新在于信用分配机制的重设计：标准组相对目标对同等奖励响应分配相同优势，使聚合信用与采样模式频率成正比，从而抑制稀有但正确解法的留存。ExPPO 改用'提示相对、长度归一化的响应意外度'结合'提示通过率'来重分配信用，并通过有界塑形与共享归一化保持验证器极性（奖励符号不被扭曲）、近似维持每个提示组的总绝对序列优势质量。这是一种在不改变奖励模型的前提下，从优化目标层面直接改善探索-利用平衡的工程化手段。
domain_disruption.business_model: 若结论在生产级 RL 训练中成立，可直接提升推理模型在固定采样预算下的解空间覆盖与正确率，等价于降低单位性能的训练算力成本，对自建推理模型的团队（模型厂、垂直领域微调方）构成降本增效路径。对推理 API 供应商而言，可能意味着同等成本下更高的 pass@k，但离重塑 SaaS 生态尚有距离，商业化路径主要走开源算法采纳与训练框架集成。

compound_value.reason: ExPPO 是一类'训练方法/算法'层面的贡献，而非可直接货币化的产品资产，其复利价值取决于能否被标准化吸收。从投资逻辑看：(1) 正向——它针对 RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）中一个真实且普遍的痛点：组相对目标（如 GRPO 系）对同等奖励响应分配相同优势，导致聚合信用与采样模式频率成正比，从而在重复采样下压制了稀有但正确的推理路径。这类'探索保持'的能力正是当前 o1/R1 式推理模型后训练的核心瓶颈，若 ExPPO 的轻量优势塑形被主流训练栈（TRL、verl、OpenRLHF 等）采纳为默认组件，它将成为推理后训练的标准工具，具备持续的引用与复用复利；(2) 负向——算法创新极易被吸收和复现，代码已开源，缺乏数据、算力或生态锁定，前沿实验室可低成本内化，作者难以独占收益，价值更多沉淀到'采用它的模型能力'而非方法本身。综合看，它有潜力成为细分（RL 后训练/探索保持）基础设施级的技巧，但需要第三方复现与规模化验证（大采样预算下的覆盖增益能否稳定转化为下游基准提升），故给予中等偏上、需持续验证的评分。

market_opportunities: 做 RLVR/RLHF 训练基础设施或微调服务的团队，可把 ExPPO 的轻量优势塑形规则（提示相对、长度归一化意外度 + 提示通过率重分配信用）作为插件式组件接入现有 GRPO 类训练管线，以较低改造成本换取推理覆盖度与答案多样性的提升，形成差异化卖点。
针对代码生成、数学推理、AI Agent 多解探索等依赖 pass@k / 大采样预算的场景，可围绕「探索保持」构建评测与调优工具链，帮助客户在固定算力下提高正确模式产出率，做训练效率优化咨询或 SaaS。
研究者与前沿实验室可基于论文给出的「熵增益与正确模式发现」局部条件做后续理论与系统化复现工作，抢先补齐工业级规模验证与大模型上的可迁移性结论，占据该细分方向的话语权。

risk_matrix.regulatory: 无直接监管风险；作为基础训练方法不触及 AI Act、出口管制或版权诉讼。但若被用于提升模型推理与探索能力，可能间接落入未来针对前沿模型能力评测与安全披露的合规框架，需关注合规口径变化。
risk_matrix.technological: 技术替代风险较高：RLVR 优势估计方向迭代极快，更简单的替代方案（提高采样量、调整 KL 正则、更换优势归一化方式）可能以更低成本取得相近收益；且论文理论结论为「局部条件」，跨规模、跨任务的泛化性尚未验证，方法对 tokenizer 与长度归一化实现细节可能敏感，复现偏差会导致收益不稳定。
risk_matrix.competitive: 竞争窗口短：DeepSeek、阿里、Meta 及开源社区对 RL 训练方法跟进极快，ExPPO 很可能迅速被吸收为开源基线或被更强方法覆盖，先发差异化难以长期维持；算力充足的大厂即便不采用该方法，也可用更粗暴的采样规模优势对冲其收益。
risk_matrix.ethical: 提升探索多样性与正确模式产出，在增强推理多样性之外，也可能同步放大有害能力的多路径生成（如绕过安全对齐的越狱式推理路径），并加剧对训练/评测数据分布偏差的放大，需要在部署侧补充安全与对齐护栏。
additional: 论文为 arXiv 预印本，尚未经同行评审，实证结论的稳健性与统计显著性未获外部检验。
实验规模与基线对比范围有限，工业级大模型上的收益与成本（额外计算、超参敏感度）尚不明确。
代码虽已公开，但训练基础设施依赖较强，第三方复现门槛不低，存在「论文效果难复现」的常见风险。

title: An Explainable Header-Centric Framework for Large-Scale Semantic Table Interpretation and Data Quality Assessment
author: [[Marcelo Valentim Silva, Hannes Herrmann, Valerie Maxville]]
description: arXiv:2610.10541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Knowledge Graph (KG) quality depends not only on downstream graph validation, but also on the quality of tabular metadata used before integration. In metadata-only Semantic Table Interpretation (STI), where cell values are unavailable, noisy, or unsuitable, column headers become a critical source of semantic evidence for traceable KG preparation. We present an explainable, header-centric framework for metadata-only Column Type Annotation (CTA) and Data Quality Assessment (DQA). The framework maps headers to 39 interpretable FinalFormat types using curated lexical resources and preserves token-level traceability through SourceKeywords. Each assigned type activates validation rules based on a taxonomy of Data Quality Issues (DQIs), producing detections such as missing data, duplicates, domain violations, wrong data type, and temporal mismatch. These detections are aggregated into HeadersIQ, a lightweight, unweighted data source-level quality metric. The framework was evaluated across heterogeneous benchmarks, including UCI, Prague, Kaggle, VizNet/Sato, SOTAB, T2Dv2, and the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, comprising around 120,000 header columns. The results show broad practical coverage across noisy real-world metadata, while a parallel KG-mapping pathway supports alignment to DBpedia and Schema.org. On the SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track, the official GT-strict evaluation was modest. However, a blinded diagnostic audit indicates that many mismatches reflect benchmark granularity, aliasing, and ontology-selection effects rather than wholly implausible header-centric predictions. We report this audit as diagnostic evidence on disagreement patterns, not as revised benchmark performance. Overall, the paper presents a reusable workflow for metadata-driven semantic annotation, data source-level quality monitoring, and KG-oriented benchmark diagnosis.
tldr: 一篇 arXiv 论文提出以表头为中心、可解释的语义表格解释框架，用于无单元格数据的列类型标注（CTA）与数据质量评估（DQA）。该框架将表头映射到 39 种可解释类型并激活数据质量问题（DQI）校验规则，聚合成 HeadersIQ 质量指标，在约 12 万列头列的多基准上评测，SemTab 2024 官方严格评测成绩一般，但盲审诊断认为多数不匹配源于基准粒度与本体选择差异。

key_logic_flow: 论文针对仅含元数据的语义表格解释（STI）场景，指出在单元格值不可用或不适用时，列头成为可追溯知识图谱准备的关键语义证据来源。
框架以表头为核心，借助精选词汇资源将表头映射到 39 种可解释的 FinalFormat 类型，并通过 SourceKeywords 保留 token 级可追溯性。
每个被赋予的类型会激活基于数据质量问题（DQI）分类法的校验规则，可检出缺失数据、重复、领域违规、错误数据类型和时间不匹配等问题。
上述检测结果聚合为 HeadersIQ，这是一个轻量级、不加权的数据源级质量指标，用于元数据驱动的语义标注与数据源质量监控。
框架在 UCI、Prague、Kaggle、VizNet/Sato、SOTAB、T2Dv2 及 SemTab 2024 Metadata-to-KG track 等基准上评测，覆盖约 120,000 个表头列，并另设 KG 映射路径对齐 DBpedia 与 Wikidata。
SemTab 2024 官方 GT-strict 评测成绩不高，但作者通过盲审诊断审计指出，多数不匹配源于基准粒度、别名和本体选择效应，并声明该审计仅为分歧模式的诊断证据而非修正成绩。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 在表头为唯一语义证据的受限场景下，提出以列头为中心的 CTA 路径：用精选词汇资源将表头映射到 39 种可解释的 FinalFormat 类型，并通过 SourceKeywords 保留 token 级可追溯性；再由类型激活基于 DQI 分类法的校验规则（缺失、重复、领域违规、类型错误、时间错配），聚合成轻量无加权的 HeadersIQ 指标。本质贡献是把'类型标注'与'质量规则触发'耦合进同一可解释流水线，并叠加一条 DBpedia/Wikidata 对齐的 KG 映射支路。
domain_disruption.business_model: 潜在商业化路径指向数据目录（Data Catalog）与数据源准入/质量监控工具：HeadersIQ 可作为元数据驱动的数据资产质量评分，嵌入数据集成与 KG 治理平台（如数据治理 SaaS、湖仓元数据层），为数据交易或数据市场提供轻量级可信度背书。但当前仅为流程级方法，缺乏规模化商业验证，短期难以重塑现有数据治理生态。

compound_value.reason: 从资本视角看，这是一篇纯学术论文（epistemic status = theoretical_claim），无公司、无产品化路径、无明确的代码/数据集发布（正文仅有 arXivLabs 样板文案），因此短期不构成可投资的商业资产。其长期复利价值取决于两点：一是'纯元数据场景下的表格列类型标注 + 数据质量评估'是否成为 KG 构建前的标准前置环节——这个环节确实真实存在且随企业数据治理与 Agent 数据接入需求上升而扩张；二是该框架的可解释性与 token 级可追溯性（SourceKeywords）能否沉淀为行业事实标准。但当前证据偏弱：SemTab 2024 官方 GT-strict 评测成绩一般，作者以'基准粒度/别名/本体选择效应'做盲审诊断解释，这属于分歧模式诊断而非性能修正，说明方法尚未被独立验证。39 种 FinalFormat 类型 + HeadersIQ 无权重指标设计轻量、可复用，具备成为细分赛道（元数据质量标注）参考实现的潜力，但缺乏护城河与生态采纳，故落在 4-7 分区间的下沿，给 3.5 分。若要上调，需观察是否被主流数据目录/数据质量产品集成或形成开源社区。

risk_matrix.competitive: SemTab 等语义表格解释赛道已有活跃的学术与工业竞争者，主流数据治理厂商与云厂商（其数据目录产品）若内置类似功能，可能挤压独立方案的空间；此外论文未确认开源代码与模型，复用门槛与生态壁垒尚不清晰。
risk_matrix.ethical: 以表头映射到固定 39 类 FinalFormat 及特定本体（DBpedia/Wikidata）会引入词汇表与本体选择偏见，可能对非英语、非西方语境的数据源产生系统性误判；数据源级质量评分若被下游用于自动化决策，存在误标与歧视性影响风险，且偏差具有隐蔽性。
additional: 可复现性风险：论文属理论主张（theoretical_claim），官方评测结果一般而作者以自审诊断解释，第三方难以独立验证其真实性能。
基准依赖风险：诊断结论高度依赖 SemTab 2024 等基准的具体构造，泛化到真实企业元数据场景的有效性仍待验证。

title: Sigma-Hunter: A Domain-Specific Language Model for Threat Hunting and Detection Engineering
author: [[Kemal Davaslioglu, Sastry Kompella]]
description: arXiv:2610.09007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detection engineers must translate threat reports, forensic observations, and hunt hypotheses into precise, testable rules. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) can draft such rules, but often produce invalid YAML, incorrect log sources, unsupported fields, or overly broad detection logic. This paper presents \emph{Sigma-Hunter}, a domain-adapted LLM for analyst-assistive Sigma rule generation and threat hunting. We build an instruction-tuning dataset from 3,635 validated open-source Sigma rules, expanded into 7,663 question-answer and analyst-reasoning examples. Each source rule is assigned to a single train, validation, or test partition before this expansion, so no rule leaks across splits. We fine-tune a 7B Mistral model and a Phi-4 model with LoRA and score held-out rule generations on syntax, approximate field consistency, and a semantic judgment of detection logic, completeness, selectivity, and log-source alignment. Sigma-Hunter-Mistral scores 8.17 overall, against 7.88 for the strongest general-purpose baseline and 4.61 for untuned Mistral. Two findings stand out: domain adaptation enables a compact 7B model to perform competitively with larger general-purpose models on this structured task, and syntactic validity is a weak proxy for semantic rule quality, as several baselines emit well-formed YAML carrying weak detection logic. The adapted models run locally, which suits detection engineering in disconnected environments where analysts cannot reach hosted model services.
tldr: Sigma-Hunter 是一款面向威胁狩猎与检测工程的领域适配大模型，基于 3,635 条开源 Sigma 规则构建指令微调数据集，微调 7B Mistral 与 Phi-4 以生成 Sigma 检测规则。其 Mistral 版本综合得分 8.17，高于最强通用基线 7.88，并可在本地离线运行。
objective_summary: 该论文提出 Sigma-Hunter，一个用于分析师辅助生成 Sigma 规则与威胁狩猎的领域适配大语言模型。作者从 3,635 条经过验证的开源 Sigma 规则出发，扩展出 7,663 条问答与分析师推理样本，并在扩展前将每条源规则划分到训练、验证或测试集，避免规则跨集泄露。研究团队使用 LoRA 微调 7B Mistral 与 Phi-4 模型，从语法、近似字段一致性以及检测逻辑、完整性、选择性和日志源对齐的语义判断等维度对留出集生成结果打分。结果显示 Sigma-Hunter-Mistral 综合得分 8.17，高于最强通用基线 7.88 和未微调 Mistral 的 4.61，并指出语法有效性并不能可靠反映规则的语义质量。
key_logic_flow: 通用大语言模型虽然可以起草检测规则，但常产生无效 YAML、错误日志源、不支持的字段或过宽的检测逻辑，因此需要面向检测工程的领域适配。
作者基于 3,635 条经过验证的开源 Sigma 规则构建指令微调数据集，扩展为 7,663 条问答与分析师推理样本，并按规则粒度预先划分训练、验证与测试集以防跨集泄露。
研究使用 LoRA 微调 7B Mistral 与 Phi-4 模型，评估维度涵盖语法、近似字段一致性，以及对检测逻辑、完整性、选择性和日志源对齐的语义判断。
评估结果显示 Sigma-Hunter-Mistral 综合得分 8.17，高于最强通用基线 7.88 和未微调 Mistral 的 4.61。
论文得出两个核心结论：领域适配使紧凑的 7B 模型在该结构化任务上可与更大的通用模型竞争，且语法有效性只是语义规则质量的弱代理指标，部分基线会输出格式正确但检测逻辑薄弱的 YAML。
适配后的模型可在本地运行，适合分析师无法访问托管模型服务的隔离（断网）环境中的检测工程工作。

impact_score.reason: 这是一篇扎实但高度垂直的学术论文：它解决的痛点是真实存在的——通用大模型生成 Sigma 检测规则时常输出无效 YAML、错误日志源或过宽的检测逻辑，作者用 3,635 条真实 Sigma 规则做领域微调并给出可复现的评测。但影响面局限在安全检测工程（detection engineering / SOC 分析师）这一小众圈层，模型规模仅 7B、任务单一、提升幅度（8.17 vs 7.88）属于渐进式而非颠覆式。它不改变 AI 行业整体竞争格局，也无法与范式级事件相提并论，因此落在'重要但小圈子'的区间。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 本质突破不在模型架构（只是标准 LoRA 微调 7B Mistral 与 Phi-4），而在于三点工程与数据方法论：一是将 3,635 条已验证开源 Sigma 规则扩展为 7,663 条问答/分析师推理样本，并在扩展前按规则粒度预划分训练/验证/测试集以杜绝跨集规则泄露；二是构建了覆盖语法、近似字段一致性及检测逻辑/完整性/选择性/日志源对齐的多维语义评测体系，并以实证说明语法有效性无法可靠代表语义规则质量；三是验证了紧凑 7B 模型在高度结构化的领域任务上可与更大通用模型竞争。
domain_disruption.business_model: 推演其商业化路径：面向 SOC/威胁情报的'本地化检测规则生成'可成为 SIEM/XDR 与检测工程工具链的新能力层，尤其在政府、军工、金融等无法访问托管大模型服务的隔离网络中具备刚需。它可能推动安全管理平台从'卖规则库'转向'卖可离线运行的领域微调模型 + 规则质量评测'，并倒逼通用模型厂商在安全等敏感垂直场景面临被轻量领域模型替代的压力。

compound_value.reason: 单看 Sigma-Hunter 本身，它是一篇开源社区产物（数据源自 3,635 条开放的 Sigma 规则、基座是可本地部署的 7B Mistral），既不占据算力也不锁定专有数据，短期商业估值有限。但其真正的复利价值在于验证并强化了一条可复用的资本叙事：'小参数 + 领域数据 + LoRA = 垂直场景媲美大模型，且能离线运行'。这一范式一旦在安全运营（SOC）这类高合规、断网可部署、长尾规则密集的垂直场景被验证，会沉淀为可迁移的工程方法论和数据集资产，向合规审计、工控安全、医疗/金融风控等同类高壁垒领域外溢。它的护城河不在模型权重，而在高质量领域语料（验证过的检测规则）+ 语义级评估标准（论文指出语法有效只是弱代理，语义逻辑才是真门槛）——这是可以持续积累、越用越强的资产。因此具备成为细分赛道基础设施的潜力，但需后续产品化与生态采纳持续验证，故给 6.5 分而非更高。

title: REACT: Physically and Chemically Consistent Reconstruction of Marine Active Tracers
author: [[Wenbin Dai, Hao Zheng, Shiyu Liang, Chaofan Sun, Xueying Zhang, Hanbo Huang, Xuan Gong, Yiran Zhang, Enhui Liao]]
description: arXiv:2610.03888v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reconstructing global sea surface pH from sparse observations is critical for monitoring ocean acidification and understanding marine carbon cycling. Traditional assimilation and inverse models are physically grounded but costly for large-scale reconstruction. Recent black-box and physics-guided AI models improve efficiency, but are mainly designed for passive tracers, where the reconstructed variable is also the transported inventory. In contrast, pH is an active carbonate tracer: it is the prediction target, while dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) is the conserved carbon inventory. This mismatch can produce low pH error while violating carbonate closure and source-free carbon conservation. To address this, we introduce \textbf{REACT}, a carbon-first reconstruction framework that decouples transport, active correction, and chemical decoding. REACT transports a latent carbonate state with a conservative advection--diffusion solver, captures non-conservative carbon-cycle variations with a source module, decodes the corrected state into pH, and constrains the output through carbonate equilibrium. This design keeps pH as the target while enforcing consistency on the underlying carbon state. On simulation data, REACT reduces pH NRMSE by (14.7%) and chemical consistency error by (24.0%) over the best baseline. Cross-temporal-scale evaluations show robustness against error accumulation from coarse to fine temporal scales, and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component.
tldr: 论文提出 REACT，一种碳优先的海洋主动示踪物重建框架，通过解耦传输、主动校正与化学解码来重建全球海表 pH。在模拟数据上，其 pH NRMSE 相比最佳基线降低 14.7%，化学一致性误差降低 24.0%。
objective_summary: 该研究针对从稀疏观测重建全球海表 pH 的任务，指出传统同化与反演模型物理可靠但大规模重建成本高昂，而近期黑箱与物理引导 AI 模型虽提升效率却主要面向被动示踪物。由于 pH 属于主动碳酸盐示踪物，预测目标为 pH 而守恒碳储量是溶解无机碳（DIC），直接重建会违反碳酸盐闭合与无源碳守恒。为此作者提出 REACT 框架，将传输、主动校正与化学解码解耦：用守恒的平流—扩散求解器传输潜在碳酸盐状态，用源模块捕捉非守恒碳循环变化，再将校正后状态解码为 pH 并通过碳酸盐平衡约束输出。在模拟数据上，REACT 相较最佳基线将 pH NRMSE 降低 14.7%、化学一致性误差降低 24.0%，跨时间尺度评估显示其能抑制从粗到细时间尺度的误差累积，消融实验验证了各组件有效性。
key_logic_flow: 从稀疏观测重建全球海表 pH 对监测海洋酸化与理解海洋碳循环至关重要，但传统同化与反演模型在大规模重建时成本高昂。
近期黑箱与物理引导 AI 模型提升了效率，却主要针对被动示踪物设计，而 pH 是主动碳酸盐示踪物，其预测目标与守恒碳储量（溶解无机碳 DIC）并不一致。
这种不匹配会导致 pH 误差虽低，却违反碳酸盐闭合与无源碳守恒。
REACT 采用碳优先框架，将传输、主动校正与化学解码解耦，用守恒的平流—扩散求解器传输潜在碳酸盐状态，并用源模块捕捉非守恒碳循环变化。
该框架将校正后的状态解码为 pH，并通过碳酸盐平衡约束输出，从而在保持 pH 为目标的同时保证底层碳状态的一致性。
在模拟数据上，REACT 将 pH NRMSE 降低 14.7%、化学一致性误差降低 24.0%，跨时间尺度评估显示其能抑制误差累积，消融实验验证了各组件有效性。

title: How Could AI Eliminate Humanity? A Failure-Mode Analysis of Civilizational Risk
author: [[Miko{\l}aj Sienicki, Krzysztof Sienicki]]
description: arXiv:2610.08878v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article develops a failure-mode framework for analyzing how advanced artificial intelligence could contribute to human extinction, irreversible civilizational collapse, or permanent human disempowerment. The central thesis is that catastrophic AI risk does not require consciousness, hostility, or an explicit intention to harm humanity. Instead, risk may arise through several distinct but interacting pathways, including autonomous misalignment, harmful human use, organizational failure, and competitive deployment. The severity of these pathways depends on factors such as capability, autonomy, external access, persistence, institutional safeguards, and the preservation of recovery capacity. The analysis is deliberately non-operational: it identifies causal conditions, empirically tractable intermediate quantities, and defensive research questions rather than procedures for causing harm.
tldr: 该论文提出一个"失效模式"框架，用于分析先进人工智能如何可能导致人类灭绝、不可逆的文明崩溃或人类的永久性失能。其核心论点是灾难性 AI 风险并不需要意识、敌意或明确伤害人类的意图，而可能通过自主失准、人类有害使用、组织失败与竞争性部署等多条相互作用的路径产生。
objective_summary: 这篇 arXiv 论文（编号 2610.08878）提出一个失效模式框架，用于分析先进人工智能如何促成人类灭绝、不可逆的文明崩溃或人类的永久性失能。作者主张，灾难性 AI 风险并不必然源于意识、敌意或蓄意伤害，而可能来自自主失准、人类有害使用、组织失败与竞争性部署等既独立又相互作用的路径。风险的严重程度取决于能力、自主性、外部访问、持续性、制度保障以及恢复能力的保存程度等要素。该分析刻意保持非操作性，仅识别因果条件、可实证追踪的中间量以及防御性研究问题，而不提供造成伤害的具体流程。

title: An Empirical Study of Agent Skills' Downstream Utility
author: [[Yu Cheng, Dehai Zhao, Zhongxin Liu, Qing Huang, Zhenchang Xing, Xiaoxue Ren]]
description: arXiv:2610.08875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent Skills package procedural guidance and resources for reuse, but a relevant Skill does not necessarily improve task performance. Existing studies characterize Skill content and evaluate downstream performance, yet provide limited explanations of how utility depends on content, execution configuration, and multi-Skill organization. We conduct an empirical study on 87 SkillsBench tasks, defining downstream utility as the pass-rate difference from No-Skill on the same tasks under the same model--harness configuration. We compare the same Skills across nine configurations, then examine alternative published Skills and organizations of fixed Skill sets under three selected configurations. We retrieve marketplace candidates from a curated corpus of 37,596 Skills. LLM-assisted analysis of content, execution traces, and final artifacts, followed by author review, relates provided support to actual use and task outcomes. The same Skills help some configurations and hurt others on 36.78\% of tasks, with trajectories showing that recommended procedures can become an execution burden. Relevance rankings overlook more useful candidates. Within the evaluated candidate sets, reranking by support for required operations raises first-choice pass rates by 4.35--5.80 percentage points across the three configurations. We derive 17 authoring practices linking executable procedures to recovery, preservation of task requirements, and checks on final artifacts. Stage Plan and Dependency DAG outperform use order alone, with DAG's additional benefits concentrated in tasks supplied with five or six Skills. These findings guide developers to assess usable operation support, allow procedure adaptation while preserving task requirements, and make artifact dependencies explicit when organizing Skills.
tldr: 一项针对 87 个 SkillsBench 任务的实证研究，将 Agent Skills 的下游效用定义为相同模型-执行框架配置下相对无 Skill 的通过率差值。同一批 Skill 在九个配置中，对 36.78% 的任务在一部分配置有帮助、在另一部分配置反而有害。

title: MLLMs Fail to Refuse when Using Tools Agentically
author: [[Rikiya Takehi, Ryo Hachiuma, Shaona Ghosh, Dan Zhao, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Yusuke Hirota]]
description: arXiv:2610.03938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently pushed the frontier of visual reasoning by calling tools such as zooming and tagging. Despite the recent strong success of agentic MLLMs, this work uncovers a critical safety failure in the tool-use paradigm: agentic tool-using MLLMs become less capable of refusing harmful requests. Our experiments confirm that, across three popular safety benchmarks, all the top open- and closed-weight MLLMs we test exhibit significantly lower safety in tool-using settings than in non-tool settings, with a relative refusal failure rate increase of up to 68.7%. Based on analysis of 100,000+ responses, including extended experiments, we also propose two possible reasons for this safety degradation.
tldr: 一项研究发现，具备工具调用能力的智能体式多模态大模型（MLLM）在调用工具时会显著降低对有害请求的拒绝能力，在三个主流安全基准上测试的所有开源与闭源 MLLM 均出现安全性下降，拒绝失败率相对上升最高达 68.7%。
objective_summary: 该 arXiv 论文（编号 2610.03938）研究智能体式工具使用范式下的多模态大模型安全问题。作者在三个主流安全基准上测试了多个顶级开源与闭源 MLLM，发现这些模型在启用工具调用（如缩放、标注）时的安全性显著低于不使用工具的设置，拒绝失败率相对增加最高达 68.7%。研究基于对 10 万余条模型响应的分析及扩展实验，提出了造成这一安全性下降的两种可能原因。
key_logic_flow: 论文揭示了智能体式工具使用范式中的一个关键安全缺陷：调用工具的 MLLM 变得更难以拒绝有害请求。
作者在三个主流安全基准上进行了实验，覆盖多个顶级开源与闭源 MLLM。
所有被测试模型在使用工具的设置下安全性均显著低于不使用工具的设置，拒绝失败率相对增加最高达 68.7%。
研究基于对 10 万余条模型响应的分析以及扩展实验，提出了两种可能导致安全性下降的原因。

compound_value.reason: 这是一篇揭示系统性安全缺陷的研究论文，本身不直接产生现金流，但其复利价值体现在两点：(1) 它把'智能体工具调用会系统性削弱拒绝能力'这一现象从个案上升为对全体开源/闭源 MLLM 的普适性结论（相对拒绝失败率最高上升 68.7%），为下一代安全对齐研究划定了新问题域，后续的 guardrail、评测基准、对齐方法都将以此为基准引用，具备成为'赛道标准引用点'的潜力；(2) 它暴露的是横跨所有厂商的通用风险，因而会加速企业级 Agent 部署中'安全中间层'的独立采购预算。但论文缺乏可直接商业化的技术资产，安全类研究的知识半衰期又相对较短（攻击与防御快速迭代），难以像底层基础设施那样形成 3-5 年持续收租的护城河，故不给 8 分以上。

title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
author: [[Chien-Ping Lu]]
description: arXiv:2610.10611v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic AI systems can improve by searching longer, receiving additional support, or modifying how they propose and verify outputs. A performance score does not distinguish these mechanisms. We compare these changes through bounded verification with hidden terminal randomness. A stage specifies admissible transcripts, polynomial bounds, an alternating verification protocol, and a terminal checker. Its native reach uses default support; its closure frontier permits all support already admitted by the interface. Under a uniform pointwise probability gap and task-relative soundness, these are well-defined languages. We prove that independent majority amplification preserves both languages, whereas existential acceptance over random tapes can admit incorrect outputs. Exact verification is the zero-randomness case, with placement and completeness results. The randomized-verifier classes satisfy $\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{P}}\subseteq\Sigma_k^{\mathrm{RV}}\subseteq\Sigma_{k+1}^{\mathrm{P}}$; strict enlargement and depth separation require explicit complexity assumptions, while $\mathrm{BPP}=\mathrm{P}$ yields exact companions with the same frontiers. Representation analysis separates invariant acceptance from core-versus-support labels that can change under refactoring. For recursive self-improvement, uniformly bounded self-modification under a common sound interpreter and fixed verification protocol remains within the same verification class. A separate conditional-error budget controls false selection across adaptively chosen candidates. A quota-enforced XOR-synthesis family separates unbounded ratios of search success from changes in the accepted languages; exact and probabilistic audits check the resulting evidence requirements. The framework ties self-improvement claims to obligations on correctness, admissible evidence, verification resources, and selection error.
tldr: 一篇 arXiv 论文提出用「带隐藏终端随机性的有界验证」框架来区分 Agentic AI 的性能提升机制，证明独立多数表决可保持验证语言不变，而基于随机磁带的存在式接受可能产生错误输出。
objective_summary: arXiv 论文《Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits》提出一个理论框架，用「阶段」（stage）来刻画可采纳的转录、多项式界、交替验证协议与终端检查器，并区分默认支持下的原生可达集与允许全部界面支持下的闭包前沿。作者在逐点概率间隙与任务相对可靠性假设下证明这些是良定义语言，独立多数表决放大同时保持两类语言，而随机磁带上的存在式接受可能接纳错误输出。论文给出随机验证类满足 Σ_k^P ⊆ Σ_k^RV ⊆ Σ_{k+1}^P 的包含关系，并分析递归自我改进中一致有界自修改仍停留在同一验证类，最后用配额强制 XOR 合成族分离搜索成功率与可接受语言的变化。
key_logic_flow: 论文指出性能分数无法区分 Agentic AI 系统是通过更长搜索、额外支持还是修改提议与验证方式获得提升，因此需要更精细的验证框架。
作者提出「阶段」概念，包含可采纳转录、多项式界、交替验证协议与终端检查器，并定义原生可达集与闭包前沿两种语言。
在逐点概率间隙与任务相对可靠性假设下，论文证明独立多数表决放大能同时保持两类语言，而随机磁带上的存在式接受可能接纳错误输出。
随机验证类满足 Σ_k^P ⊆ Σ_k^RV ⊆ Σ_{k+1}^P，严格扩大与深度分离需要显式复杂度假设，而 BPP=P 会给出具有相同前沿的精确伴随类。
论文分析递归自我改进：在共同可靠解释器与固定验证协议下，一致有界的自修改仍停留在同一验证类内。
配额强制的 XOR 合成族分离了搜索成功率的无界比率与可接受语言的变化，并配套精确与概率审计来检查证据要求。

title: AgentHorizon: Evaluating Agentic Judges for Long-Horizon Computer-Use Tasks
author: [[Xing Han L\`u, Dheeraj Vattikonda, Sina Hajimiri, Fatemeh Pesaran Zadeh, Parishad BehnamGhader, Ghazwa Darwiche, Amirhossein Kazemnejad, Christopher Pal, Alexandre Drouin, Siva Reddy]]
description: arXiv:2610.11050v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computer-use agents are capable of completing complex tasks, increasing the use of automatic judges to determine success, either for training or for evaluation without human involvement. Despite their flexibility, their reliability on long tasks spanning multiple applications remains unclear. A trajectory, composed of long sequences of screenshots and actions, may appear complete, but in reality violates constraints from the instruction or introduces an unwanted side effect. To identify these errors, a judge needs to examine the trajectory with respect to the user's instruction. To this end, we introduce AgentHorizon, a benchmark of 1,373 computer-use tasks (instruction-trajectory pairs) drawn from 166 hours of human-recorded trajectories spanning three operating systems. By recording trajectories for closely related instructions, we can construct negative tasks by swapping the instructions. This paired design evaluates judges on their ability to distinguish a successful trajectory from one that completed a similar (but incompatible) request. We release the benchmark under three splits: a frontier split, AgentHorizon (AH), a simplified split, AgentHorizon-Simple (AH-S), and a development split, AgentHorizon-Development (AH-D). We further evaluate eleven judges by (1) directly passing the full trajectory (with up to 300 screenshots and actions), and (2) using them as coding agents across five agent harnesses. We find that our best agentic judge, GPT-5.5, achieves 80.9% balanced accuracy on the AH subset. We find that tool-use improves certain models but results in worse performance for open-weight models, and that judges differ drastically in their ability to accept a valid trajectory and reject failed ones. Our findings highlight the need for judges that are capable of locating and verifying often hidden evidence that a task was properly completed inside long interaction histories.
tldr: 研究者发布 AgentHorizon 基准，包含 1,373 个计算机操作任务，用于评估自动评判智能体判断长时程任务成败的可靠性，最佳智能体评判 GPT-5.5 在 AH 子集上达到 80.9% 的平衡准确率。
objective_summary: 针对计算机操作智能体（computer-use agents）在长时程任务中自动评判可靠性不明的问题，研究者提出 AgentHorizon 基准，包含 1,373 个指令-轨迹对，取自跨越三种操作系统的 166 小时人类操作录像。通过为相近指令录制轨迹并互换指令来构造负样本任务，该配对设计用于考察评判者能否区分成功轨迹与完成了相似但不相容请求的轨迹。基准分为三个子集：AgentHorizon（AH）、AgentHorizon-Simple（AH-S）和 AgentHorizon-Development（AH-D），并评估了十一名评判者的两种使用方式：直接传入完整轨迹（最多 300 张截图与动作），或将其作为编程智能体接入五种智能体框架。结果显示最强智能体评判 GPT-5.5 在 AH 子集上取得 80.9% 平衡准确率，工具调用对部分模型有帮助但对开放权重模型反而有害。
key_logic_flow: 计算机操作智能体的自动化评判被广泛用于训练与无人工评估，但其在跨多应用的长时程任务上的可靠性尚不明确。
一条由长序列截图和动作组成的轨迹可能看似完成，却违反指令约束或引入非预期副作用，因此评判者需要结合用户指令审查轨迹。
研究者构建了 AgentHorizon 基准，包含 1,373 个指令-轨迹对，来自跨越三种操作系统的 166 小时人类操作录像。
通过为相近指令录制轨迹并互换指令构造负样本任务，该配对设计考察评判者能否区分成功轨迹与完成相似但不兼容请求的轨迹。
基准分为 AH、AH-S、AH-D 三个子集，并评估十一名评判者的两种使用方式：直接传入完整轨迹，或作为编程智能体接入五种智能体框架。
结果显示最佳智能体评判 GPT-5.5 在 AH 子集上达到 80.9% 平衡准确率，工具调用对部分模型有益但对开放权重模型有害，不同评判者在接受有效轨迹与拒绝失败轨迹上差异显著。

compound_value.reason: AgentHorizon 切中的是计算机操作智能体（CUA）规模化落地中最被低估的瓶颈：可靠的长时程任务自动评判。训练侧的 RL/reward 和评估侧的无人工评测都依赖评判者，而该论文用配对式负样本设计（互换相近指令）精准暴露了长轨迹中'看似完成但违反约束/引入副作用'的失败模式，方法论具备可复用性。作为评测基础设施，它有潜力成为 agentic judge 的参照基准（类比 SWE-bench/AgentBench 的地位），一旦被前沿实验室与 CUA 产品团队纳入回归测试与数据筛选管线，就具备持续复利效应。但需警惕三点：(1) 基准类资产的护城河天然偏弱，易被新一代基准取代，且缺乏直接变现路径；(2) 论文本身是开源公开成果，价值更多流向采用它的模型/产品方而非基准创建者；(3) 结论强绑定 GPT-5.5 等特定模型快照，半年内即可能过时。综合看，它更接近'细分赛道基础设施的候选者'而非行业基石，给 6.5 分而非 8+。

title: Behavioral History Outperforms Descriptions of the Person for LLM Synthetic Personas
author: [[Khashayar Pourtaheri, Ahmad Zareei]]
description: arXiv:2610.03998v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic personas representing survey respondents. Their validity as substitutes for particular respondents depends on whether they reproduce individuals' decisions. We examine what information helps synthetic respondents predict each individual's later choices, using five conditions that add progressively richer information: no personal information, demographics, personality traits, cognitive scores, and finally the respondent's earlier survey choices as behavioral history. We use a two-wave panel of 845 US adults who completed measures of 14 behavioral biases (spanning risk, time preferences, overconfidence, and reasoning), so each respondent's earlier answers provide a human test-retest benchmark; in the behavioral-history condition, all items that score the target bias are withheld. At the population level, the average number of biases per respondent in every condition is close to the human average (7.1-8.1 biases, against 7.1 for humans). This aggregate similarity masks differences in variance: persona descriptions recover only 53-67% of human between-person variation, whereas adding behavioral history restores it to approximately the human level. At the individual level, description-based personas achieve only 7-12% of the informedness observed in human test-retest responses, while adding behavioral history raises this to 28%. The condition including behavioral history has the highest estimated informedness in all 17 demographic groups, whereas description-based conditions provide little or no information for some groups. Synthetic responses also exhibit stronger education- and income-related differences than human responses. For LLM synthetic personas, a respondent's past answers add more to individual-level prediction than a description of who they are.
tldr: 一项基于 845 名美国成年人两轮调查的研究显示，为 LLM 合成的用户画像（synthetic personas）提供受访者过往作答（行为历史）比提供人口统计、性格特质或认知分数等描述信息更能预测其个体层面的选择。
objective_summary: 该研究使用 845 名美国成年人组成的两轮调查面板，涵盖风险偏好、时间偏好、过度自信与推理等 14 种行为偏差，用以评估不同信息条件下 LLM 合成受访者对个体后续选择的预测能力。研究设置五个递进信息条件：无个人信息、人口统计、性格特质、认知分数，以及受访者此前的问卷作答（行为历史），并以人类重测结果作为基准。结果显示，群体层面各条件平均偏差数（7.1-8.1）接近人类的 7.1；但描述型画像仅恢复人类个体间差异的 53-67%，加入行为历史后可恢复到接近人类水平。个体层面，描述型画像仅达到人类重测信息量的 7-12%，加入行为历史后提升至 28%，且行为历史条件在全部 17 个人口统计群体中信息量最高，而合成回答在教育与收入相关差异上比人类更明显。
key_logic_flow: 研究关注 LLM 合成的受访者画像能否复现个体的真实决策，从而判断其作为调查受访者替代品的有效性，采用两轮调查面板的 845 名美国成年人作为样本。
研究覆盖风险偏好、时间偏好、过度自信与推理等 14 种行为偏差，涵盖五个递进信息条件：无信息、人口统计、性格特质、认知分数以及受访者此前作答的行为历史。
群体层面各条件平均偏差数（7.1-8.1）接近人类基准 7.1，但这一总体相似掩盖了方差差异：描述型画像仅恢复人类个体间差异的 53-67%，加入行为历史后可恢复到接近人类水平。
个体层面描述型画像仅达到人类重测信息量的 7-12%，而加入行为历史后提升至 28%。
包含行为历史的条件在全部 17 个人口统计群体中信息量估计值最高，而描述型条件对部分群体几乎不提供信息。
合成回答在教育与收入相关差异上表现出比人类响应更强的区别，研究结论是受访者以往答案对个体层面预测的贡献大于对其身份的描述。

impact_score.reason: 这是一项针对 LLM 合成受访者（synthetic personas）有效性的实证研究，用 845 人两轮调查面板、14 种行为偏差、五个递进信息条件做了系统对比。它属于方法论层面的重要发现——指出描述型画像（人口统计/性格/认知分数）在个体层面仅有 7-12% 的人类重测信息量，而行为历史可提升至 28%，揭示了当前 persona 工程的根本局限。这对依赖合成用户的调研、A/B 测试、社会模拟类应用有直接指导意义，但它是学术性结论而非产品发布，不构成范式转移，短期只改变局部方法论认知，故评分落在中段偏下。

domain_disruption.business_model: 对合成用户市场（消费者洞察、市场调研、A/B 预演、社会行为模拟）具有直接冲击：若描述型画像无法复现个体差异，则宣称可'替代受访者'的商业价值被大幅削弱。潜在商业化路径是转向基于真实行为历史/日志的个性化合成代理，催生'行为数据即画像'的新型调研与仿真 SaaS，同时抬高对隐私合规、行为数据获取壁垒的要求。

compound_value.reason: 该研究的核心价值不在模型本身，而在揭示了一个可复用的杠杆点：个体层面的预测力来自『行为历史』这一纵向数据，而非人口统计/性格/认知分数等描述型画像。它把 LLM 合成的竞争维度从模型规模转向对个体行为轨迹的占有与重放，这一原则具有跨场景复利性——一旦被验证，将成为个性化 agent、合成用户调研、行为预测产品的基础设计范式。但它目前仍是理论性、单篇论文级的发现，缺乏产品化载体与工程实证（28% 信息量虽较 7-12% 大幅提升，仍远低于人类重测），且受限于需要昂贵的两轮纵向面板数据。因此它是『有潜力成为细分基础设施、但需持续验证』的量级，而非 3-5 年后必然的行业基石。评分逻辑：方向正确、杠杆明确（+），但落地依赖数据获取壁垒与商业化验证（-）。

risk_matrix.ethical: 基于真实个人历史行为合成「行为替身」涉及隐私与二次使用同意问题；研究同时发现合成回答在教育与收入相关差异上比人类更强，可能放大偏见与刻板印象、强化群体分化；若广泛用于替代真实受访者，还可能削弱对真实人群的代表性与研究伦理基础。
additional: 方法论风险：以人类重测作为信息量基准本身含测量误差，行为历史条件中撤回目标偏见相关题目可能引入信息泄漏或偏差，结论稳健性需更多独立复现验证。
外部效度风险：样本局限于美国成年人，行为偏差与文化、制度环境高度相关，直接迁移到其他市场或 B2B 场景可能失效。

title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
author: [[Ravil Akhtyamov]]
description: arXiv:2610.10629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-improving LLM agents can adapt a credit pipeline to a changed rule, but an agent that rewrites itself destroys the artefact a supervisor reviews: a named change, a recorded test, an approval. We argue that self-evolution is reviewable only if it is confined to the runtime harness (instruction text, tool-call logic and primitive composition) while model weights stay fixed, so that every adaptation is a diff with a cause and a test attached. We give a dual-loop engine built on that bound, with one admission gate that writes a hash-chained record before deployment, and we measure the gate in simulation, with a simulated agent and a seeded-search proposer rather than language models. Across three families of supervisory re-interpretation at three severities, 10 seeds each, the gated loop admitted 144 of 7,449 candidate changes, none of which worsened error on held-out history, and restored the false-positive rate to the oracle level without raising missed flags in every low- and mid-severity cell. With the gate replaced by the check an unbounded system applies (fewer errors visible in recent traces), the same loops admitted 309 harmful changes and left missed flags above 10% in 49 of 90 runs: false positives fell because the screen was loosened. Evaluated on pre-shift labels, the gate rejected every candidate, so a re-interpretation must be encoded as a rule that relabels history. Parametric and scope shifts were repaired locally, a structural one only by primitive replacement; at the highest structural severity the gate's fixed tolerance blocked the correct replacement in half the seeds. We map the mechanisms to the EU AI Act's provisions for high-risk credit scoring and note that the April 2026 US model-risk guidance excludes agentic AI from its scope.
tldr: 该论文主张 LLM 智能体的自我演化应仅限运行时 harness（指令文本、工具调用逻辑与基础组件组合），模型权重保持固定，使每次改动都成为可审阅的 diff。作者提出带哈希链准入闸门的双环引擎并在模拟中测量：闸门从 7,449 个候选变更中仅放行 144 个，且未恶化留出历史错误。
objective_summary: 该 arXiv 论文（编号 2610.10629）提出一种合规受限的 LLM 智能体自我演化机制：自我演化仅允许发生在运行时 harness（指令文本、工具调用逻辑与基础组件组合）内，模型权重保持固定，从而让每次适配都成为附带成因与测试的可审阅 diff。作者构建了一个双环引擎，并由部署前的准入闸门写入哈希链记录；实验以模拟智能体和种子搜索提议器而非语言模型进行。在三类监督重新解释、三种严重度、每种 10 个种子的测试中，带闸门循环从 7,449 个候选变更中接纳 144 个，均未恶化留出历史错误，并在所有低与中严重度单元中将假阳性率恢复到 oracle 水平且未提高漏报。作为对照，若用无界系统所采用的检查替代闸门，同一循环接纳了 309 个有害变更，90 次运行中有 49 次漏报率超过 10%。
key_logic_flow: 论文将 LLM 智能体的自我演化限制在运行时 harness（指令文本、工具调用逻辑与基础组件组合）内，同时保持模型权重固定，以确保每次适配都是带成因与测试的可审阅 diff。
作者设计了一个基于该边界约束的双环引擎，并在部署前通过准入闸门写入哈希链记录，实验在模拟环境中以模拟智能体和种子搜索提议器而非语言模型进行。
在 30 个实验单元（三类监督重新解释 × 三种严重度 × 10 个种子）中，带闸门循环从 7,449 个候选变更中仅接纳 144 个，均未恶化留出历史错误，并把低、中严重度的假阳性率恢复到 oracle 水平而未提高漏报。
对照组用无界系统所采用的检查替代闸门后，同一循环接纳了 309 个有害变更，90 次运行中有 49 次漏报率超过 10%，说明假阳性下降源于筛选被放宽。
在迁移前标签上评估时闸门拒绝了全部候选，表明重新解释必须编码为重新标注历史的规则；参数与范围偏移可本地修复，结构性偏移只能通过基础组件替换修复，最高结构严重度下闸门的固定容差在半个种子中阻断了正确替换。
作者将该机制映射到 EU AI Act 针对高风险信用评分的条款，并指出 2026 年 4 月的美国模型风险指引将智能体 AI 排除在其适用范围之外。

title: Humanize: Judgement Engineering for Agentic Coding
author: [[Sihao Liu, Ligeng Zhu, Zijian Zhang, Dongyun Zou, Zhengyang Zhang, Changye Li, Song Bian, Song Han, Tony Nowatzki]]
description: arXiv:2610.08900v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic coding makes code generation cheap, but reliable completion remains difficult: the agent that writes the code is a weak judge of whether it is done. We present Humanize, a multi-agent orchestration workflow for agentic coding built around judgement engineering: explicit, mechanically enforced decisions at the boundaries between planning, implementation, review, and learning. A human approves a plan contract, a builder agent implements it in rounds, and a reviewer agent from another vendor decides completion; deterministic hooks, not a model, route work between these roles and enforce 72 mechanical gates. Viewed as a Markov chain over repository states, alternating builder and reviewer samples jointly from two models, so a defect survives only if both miss it. We study Humanize through its deployment, 118 public postmortems of real loops, and its applications. Over 68 versions in 108 days, it gathered 1,468 GitHub stars. Applications include a 567-file gem5 build-system migration under upstream review; Kernel Design Agents, which extend the loop with a kernel knowledge base and profiling feedback and placed in the top three of all three Full-Agent tracks of the MLSys 2026 FlashInfer contest; and, through Humanize Olympiad Agents (HOA), full scores in IOI 2026, IMO 2026, IPhO 2026, and IBO 2024, 418.5/437 in IChO 2026 (gold-medal). Humanize also achieves 672/672 on PutnamBench and ranks first (251/303) on Lean-Eval's leaderboard even competiting with professional mathematicians. The postmortems show that independent review catches unsupported builder claims, but stopping remains a key weakness. In reports that separate rounds by phase, two thirds of rounds occurred after implementation was accepted. This evidence is observational, not a controlled comparison of workflows.
tldr: Humanize 是一个面向 agentic coding 的多智能体编排工作流，核心是「判断工程」：由人类批准计划契约，builder 智能体分轮实现，来自另一厂商的 reviewer 智能体判定是否完成，确定性钩子而非模型强制执行 72 道机械门控。它在 108 天内迭代 68 个版本、获 1468 个 GitHub star，并在 gem5 迁移、MLSys 2026 FlashInfer 竞赛及多项奥赛与数学基准中取得成果。
objective_summary: arXiv 论文《Humanize: Judgement Engineering for Agentic Coding》提出 Humanize，一种围绕「判断工程」构建的多智能体编排工作流，用于提升 agentic coding 的可靠完成率。其机制为：人类批准计划契约，builder 智能体按轮实现，来自另一厂商的 reviewer 智能体判定完成，由确定性钩子而非模型在规划、实现、评审、学习之间路由工作并执行 72 道机械门控，作者将其建模为仓库状态上的马尔可夫链，使缺陷只有在两个模型同时漏检时才会幸存。研究基于部署经验、118 份真实循环的公开事后复盘及应用案例，在 108 天、68 个版本内获得 1468 个 GitHub star。应用包括受上游审查的 567 文件 gem5 构建系统迁移、在 MLSys 2026 FlashInfer 竞赛三个 Full-Agent 赛道均进入前三的 Kernel Design Agents，以及通过 Humanize Olympiad Agents 在 IOI 2026、IMO 2026、IPhO 2026、IBO 2024
key_logic_flow: agentic coding 让代码生成变得廉价，但可靠完成仍很困难，因为写代码的智能体本身是判断任务是否完成的弱评审者。
Humanize 通过「判断工程」在规划、实现、评审、学习之间设置显式且机械强制的决策边界，由人类批准计划契约。
builder 智能体分轮实现计划，来自另一厂商的 reviewer 智能体判定完成，确定性钩子而非模型负责路由并强制执行 72 道机械门控。

title: Teaching Agents to Code Reliably
author: [[Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin, Myeongsoo Kim, Kangrui Ruan, Shweta Garg, Varun Kumar, Murali Krishna Ramanathan]]
description: arXiv:2610.03984v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous coding agents solve repository issues by reading code, running commands, editing files, and submitting patches. Extra inference-time compute yields gains only when it produces a useful repair and supplies reliable evidence for choosing one. Three behaviors decide both, and we argue they are teachable rather than byproducts of scale, so a policy can carry them instead of a scaffold. Location diversity remains narrow, since attempts return to the same site and extra samples add no coverage. Edit diversity is left unexploited, since methodologies that differ resolve complementary issues no single run reaches. Verification misleads, since a test the agent writes for its own patch accepts many incorrect ones. Directing search by execution feedback and scoring each patch against its own reverted tree resolves 52.8% of SWE-bench Verified using 48.1% of the agent-steps an eight-sample baseline spends. Training moves these behaviors into the policy. On the 270 issues held out from SFT and RL training, weighted supervised fine-tuning raises pass@1 from 31.9% to 35.2% and pass@8 from 46.7% to 51.1%. A reinforcement objective then trains the verifier against gold-labeled repairs and incorrect variants, crediting the assertions that detect them. It raises pass@1 to 43.0% and pass@8 to 60.7%, lifts verifier precision from 26.8% to 41.7%, and more than halves false acceptance. Resolution improves on two of three out-of-distribution suites and verifier precision on all three, and the gains hold at 7B, 14B, and 30B against published coder baselines.
tldr: 该论文提出将位置多样性、编辑多样性和验证三项行为通过训练内化到策略中，而非依赖规模自然涌现。通过执行反馈引导搜索并针对补丁自身的回退树评分，以 8 样本基线 48.1% 的智能体步数解决 SWE-bench Verified 的 52.8%；经加权监督微调与强化学习后，pass@1 提升至 43.0%、pass@8 提升至 60.7%。
objective_summary: 论文《Teaching Agents to Code Reliably》研究自主编码智能体解决仓库问题的可靠性，提出位置多样性狭窄、编辑多样性未被利用、验证误导这三项行为是可训练的，而非规模带来的副产物。方法通过执行反馈引导搜索，并针对每个补丁自身的回退树进行评分，在 SWE-bench Verified 上使用 8 样本基线 48.1% 的智能体步数解决了 52.8% 的问题。在 270 个从 SFT 与 RL 训练中留出的问题上，加权监督微调将 pass@1 从 31.9% 提升至 35.2%、pass@8 从 46.7% 提升至 51.1%；随后一个强化学习目标让验证器针对金标注修复与错误变体训练，将 pass@1 提至 43.0%、pass@8 提至 60.7%，验证器精确率从 26.8% 提升至 41.7%，并将误接受率降低一半以上。增益在三个分布外测试集中的两个上解决率提升、全部三个上验证器精确率提升，并在 7B、14B、30B 规模上相对公开 coder 基线保持。
key_logic_flow: 自主编码智能体通过阅读代码、运行命令、编辑文件并提交补丁来解决仓库问题，而额外的推理算力只有在产生有用修复并提供可靠证据时才能带来收益。
论文指出三种决定成败的行为：位置多样性狭窄（尝试回到同一位置，额外采样不增加覆盖）、编辑多样性未被利用（不同方法可解决互补问题）、验证环节误导（智能体为自己补丁编写的测试会接受大量错误补丁）。
通过执行反馈引导搜索，并将每个补丁与其自身的回退树进行评分，方法在 SWE-bench Verified 上以 8 样本基线 48.1% 的智能体步数解决了 52.8% 的问题。
训练将这些行为移入策略，在 270 个从 SFT 与 RL 训练中留出的问题上，加权监督微调将 pass@1 从 31.9% 提升至 35.2%、pass@8 从 46.7% 提升至 51.1%。
一个强化学习目标让验证器针对金标注修复与错误变体进行训练，并奖励能检测出错误变体的断言，从而将 pass@1 提至 43.0%、pass@8 提至 60.7%，验证器精确率从 26.8% 提升至 41.7%。
验证器精确率的提升使误接受率降低一半以上，解决率在三个分布外测试集中的两个上提升，验证器精确率在全部三个上提升，且增益在 7B、14B、30B 规模上相对公开 coder 基线均保持。

title: On the Clock: Towards Punctual and Productive Time-Budgeted AI Agents
author: [[Aaron Wang, Neelabh Madan, Vlad Sobal, Matthew Trager, Michael Kleinman, Elman Mansimov, Wei Xia, Stefano Soatto]]
description: arXiv:2610.10833v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study whether small LLM agents can operate effectively under explicit wall-clock time budgets by both respecting the allocated runtime and using available time productively. We evaluate Qwen3.6-27B on five competitions from MLE-Bench Lite and Qwen3-4B on Zork I (Jericho), two agentic benchmarks where additional computational time can meaningfully improve performance. In the simplest setting, where the budget is stated only in the prompt, agents fail to translate the stated budget into controlled use of time. These failures arise from gaps in time awareness, since the harness provides no timing feedback, but also because they cannot reliably anticipate the duration of actions, and do not have a learned mapping from available time to an appropriate strategy. We investigate two complementary classes of interventions: harness-based mechanisms that expose timing information and enforce deadlines, and reinforcement learning with budget-aware rewards. Injecting timing information through the harness substantially improves budget adherence for Qwen3.6-27B without measurable loss in performance, while enforcement hooks tighten adherence further. RL with GRPO achieves near-perfect budget adherence on Zork I and generalizes to held-out budgets not seen during training, but does not improve task performance over the untrained harness on MLE-Bench. Once agents are made to respect the budget, they still fail to use additional time to improve task performance. RL-trained policies learn when to stop but often fill extra time with repeated actions, and GRPO training on multiple budgets tends to collapse toward the strategy learned for the shortest budget. Our results reveal a gap between time adherence and productive time allocation, which remains a central challenge for budget-conditioned agents.
tldr: 论文研究小型 LLM 智能体能否在明确的墙钟时间预算下既遵守运行时长又高效利用时间，通过在提示中声明预算、harness 注入计时信息、以及带预算感知奖励的强化学习三类干预进行评测，发现智能体可以学会遵守时间限制，却无法利用额外时间提升任务表现。
objective_summary: 该论文（arXiv:2610.10833）研究小型 LLM 智能体在明确的墙钟时间预算下能否既遵守分配的运行时长，又有效利用可用时间。作者在 MLE-Bench Lite 的五个竞赛上评测 Qwen3.6-27B，在 Zork I（Jericho）上评测 Qwen3-4B，并测试三类干预：仅在提示中声明预算、通过 harness 暴露计时信息并强制截止、以及使用 GRPO 的预算感知强化学习。结果显示，仅靠提示声明预算时智能体无法把预算转化为受控用时会；harness 注入计时信息显著提升 Qwen3.6-27B 的预算遵守度且无性能损失，强制截止钩子进一步提升遵守度；GRPO 在 Zork I 上达到近乎完美的预算遵守并能泛化到未见预算，但在 MLE-Bench 上未提升任务表现。
key_logic_flow: 研究问题聚焦于小型 LLM 智能体能否在明确的墙钟时间预算下既守时又高效利用时间。
评测设置在 MLE-Bench Lite 的五个竞赛上使用 Qwen3.6-27B，在 Zork I（Jericho）上使用 Qwen3-4B，两者均为增加计算时间可实质提升表现的智能体基准。
基线失败：当预算仅写在提示中时，智能体因缺乏计时反馈、无法可靠预估动作时长、缺少从可用时间到合适策略的学习映射，而无法控制用时。
干预一为 harness 机制：通过暴露计时信息并强制执行截止，显著提升 Qwen3.6-27B 的预算遵守度且未造成可测量的性能损失。
干预二为带预算感知奖励的 GRPO 强化学习：在 Zork I 上实现近乎完美的预算遵守并泛化到训练中未见的预算，但在 MLE-Bench 上未改善任务表现。
核心结论：即便智能体学会遵守预算，它们仍无法用额外时间提升表现，常以重复动作填充时间，且多预算 GRPO 训练会坍缩到最短预算所学策略，暴露出时间遵守与有效时间分配之间的鸿沟。

title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
author: [[Yipeng Li, Ashutosh Hathidara, Jane Lo, Harshavardhan Abichandani, Gunraj Singh, Atin Ghosh]]
description: arXiv:2610.10549v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distributional fidelity without per-domain authoring. We introduce **Synthesis Through Simulation** (STS), a **schema--free** data synthesis paradigm in which an LLM agent generates data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs within simulated enterprise environments. Because data is generated through the same environment that defines what is valid, STS guarantees structural validity by construction while decoupling validity enforcement from distribution modeling, allowing each to be addressed independently. The **Generalist Populator** (GP), STS's domain-agnostic agent, addresses the remaining challenges of distributional fidelity and synthesis scalability: GP achieves **0.88** average marginal fidelity and **100\% constraint satisfaction** across all ten environments *without access to DB schemas*, while statistical synthesizers are inapplicable to seven due to necessary seed data requirements, and schema-privileged agents fail 82\% of trajectories on airline environment's tightly coupled workflows due to brittle task composition. We open-source the full framework, all ten environments, and generated datasets at https://github.com/SAP/synthesis-through-simulation.

title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
author: [[Peter Chen, Wotao Yin]]
description: arXiv:2610.03872v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.
tldr: 研究提出 Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery（ADSD）框架，采用"先诊断、后发现"范式：先解释数值求解器为何表现不佳，再据此发现并封装可复用的求解器技能，从而把求解器改进从试错式编辑转变为诊断、发现、实现的结构化流程，在四个数值领域提升精度、鲁棒性与效率。
objective_summary: 该研究针对 AI 智能体虽能生成科学代码却难以真正改进底层算法的问题，指出数值求解器的执行反馈通常只能暴露性能差，却很少揭示其根本原因与解决办法。为此作者提出 Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery（ADSD）框架，将数值诊断与可复用的求解器自我改进相连接，先诊断性能不佳的原因，再据此指导发现合适的数值方法，并将所得知识封装为可复用的求解器技能。研究在电力潮流方程、交流最优潮流控制、刚性常微分方程和异构扩散偏微分方程四个数值领域进行验证，结果显示求解器的精度、鲁棒性与效率均得到持续提升，其中在 GOC-500 电力潮流任务上平均求解误差降低近 71 倍，且改进可迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。
key_logic_flow: 研究动机：AI 智能体生成科学代码的能力不断增强，但生成代码并不等同于改进其背后的算法。
核心问题：对于数值求解器，执行反馈能暴露性能不佳，却很少揭示其根本原因以及应如何解决。
方法提出：作者提出 Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery（ADSD）框架，将数值诊断与可复用的求解器自我改进连接起来。
范式设计：ADSD 采用"诊断优先"范式，先解释求解器为何表现不佳，再以该诊断指导发现合适的数值方法，并将所得知识封装为可复用的求解器技能。
实验验证：在电力潮流方程、交流最优潮流控制、刚性常微分方程和异构扩散偏微分方程四个领域，ADSD 持续提升求解器精度、鲁棒性与效率。
关键结果：在 GOC-500 电力潮流任务上，ADSD 将平均求解误差降低近 71 倍，且改进可迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。

title: ROAR: Unifying Runs across Heterogeneous AI-Driven Research Systems
author: [[Leo Y. Lin, Vishakha Ramani, Z. Berkay Celik, Paul Castro, Marquita Ellis]]
description: arXiv:2610.03966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Each run of an AI-driven research system (ADRS) is an expensive search over a vast solution space, and dependable evaluation requires many runs, making run data both costly to produce and valuable to retain for large-scale analysis. Yet this data remains fragmented: teams operate in isolation, ADRS frameworks emit results in different formats, and no shared infrastructure exists to aggregate or compare runs across problems and systems. We present ROAR, a solution for systematically unifying and analyzing heterogeneous ADRS outputs. ROAR addresses two challenges: reconciling heterogeneous ADRS outputs and enabling analytics across runs with different objectives and scoring functions. We achieve this through a relational schema and parsing layer that normalize heterogeneous ADRS outputs while preserving data lineage and temporal structure, and accommodating new systems without requiring schema modifications. From building a corpus of more than 900 runs from multiple ADRS, we show how pooled data can reveal properties of problem landscapes that are difficult to observe. Consistent with prior work, runs with identical configurations may converge to different scores. We find that many runs realize most gains early, and that the effectiveness of different strategies for incorporating prior solutions into the search process varies across problems. We further show that the pooled corpus is actionable and not merely analytical by using ROAR to configure ADRS runs. Together, these results illustrate how pooled ADRS data can expose problem-dependent structure in search behavior that is difficult to detect from any single system, team, or benchmark. Such cross-cutting insights are difficult to obtain while runs remain siloed; ROAR is the first infrastructure designed to unify them.
tldr: ROAR 是一套用于统一并分析异构 AI 驱动研究系统（ADRS）输出的基础设施，通过关系型 schema 与解析层归一化不同格式的运行数据。研究基于 900 多次 ADRS 运行构建的语料库，揭示了单一系统难以观测的搜索行为规律。
objective_summary: 该论文提出 ROAR，用于系统性地统一和分析异构 AI 驱动研究系统（ADRS）的输出。ROAR 通过关系型 schema 和解析层归一化异构 ADRS 输出，同时保留数据血缘和时间结构，并能在无需修改 schema 的情况下接纳新系统；它解决了异构输出协调与跨不同目标和评分函数的分析两大挑战。研究构建了包含来自多个 ADRS 的 900 多次运行的语料库，发现相同配置的运行可能收敛到不同分数，多数运行在早期即获得大部分收益，且引入先验解的策略有效性因问题而异。作者还展示了 ROAR 可用于配置 ADRS 运行，从而证明汇总数据具备可操作性。
key_logic_flow: AI 驱动研究系统（ADRS）的每次运行都是对庞大解空间的昂贵搜索，可靠评估需要大量运行，因此运行数据既昂贵又值得为大规模分析而保留。
当前运行数据高度碎片化：团队孤立运作，各 ADRS 框架输出格式不一，缺乏共享基础设施来跨问题和系统聚合与比较运行结果。
ROAR 通过关系型 schema 和解析层归一化异构 ADRS 输出，保留数据血缘和时间结构，并支持在不修改 schema 的情况下接入新系统。
研究从多个 ADRS 构建了超过 900 次运行的语料库，证明汇总数据能揭示单一系统难以观测的问题景观特性。
分析发现相同配置的运行可能收敛到不同分数，多数运行在早期即获得大部分收益，且引入先验解策略的有效性因问题而异。
ROAR 可用于配置 ADRS 运行，说明汇总语料库具备可操作性，是首个为统一异构运行数据而设计的基础设施。

title: The Cost of a Hop: Benchmarking NLIP and A2A
author: [[Ranjan Sinha, Anindita Das, Ashika Anand Babu, Hari Palleti]]
description: arXiv:2610.04053v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous agents built on Large Language Models (LLMs) need standardized protocols to interoperate across systems. Several now exist (A2A, MCP, ACP, ANP, NLIP), but the Natural Language Interaction Protocol (NLIP) has not appeared in any controlled performance study, and no work has measured where an agent protocol's latency is spent. We compare NLIP and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol empirically, decomposing latency into message creation, connection, and send phases across three independent hardware environments. For lightweight coordination, NLIP is 8.4-9.6x faster than the baseline A2A SDK implementation on two environments and about 4x on a third; the direction of the advantage is consistent, its magnitude depends on the hardware. The advantage is stage-specific: for the end-to-end pipeline, where LLM inference dominates, the protocols are near parity. The difference comes almost entirely from connection setup. To test A2A at its best, we also ran A2A SDK with connection caching enabled; caching narrows its gap with NLIP by a hardware-dependent amount, from 2.75x on one machine to near-parity on faster hardware, where at scale a cache-optimized A2A-SDK matches NLIP. We report these as measured conditions without a single causal account of the residual send-phase cost. Against the more optimized Python-A2A, NLIP leads by about 4x on the same stage. We close with a protocol-selection guide keyed to workload characteristics.

title: AdaGuard: Enhancing Safety and Policy Compliance with Reasoning-Enabled LLM-As-A-Judge Guardrails
author: [[Melissa Kazemi Rad, Sihui Dai, Isha Slavin, Kushal Chawla, Mann Patel, Jian Ni, William M. Campbell, Stephen Rawls, Sambit Sahu]]
description: arXiv:2610.08923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise generative AI applications require robust safety mechanisms that can accommodate diverse risk postures, evolving policies, and varying latency constraints. Current guardrail solutions often suffer from rigidity, relying on fixed policy sets and offering limited transparency or reasoning flexibility. We present Adaguard, an adaptive LLM-as-a-Judge framework designed to address these challenges through dynamic policy enforcement and adaptive reasoning-budget allocation. Built using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO), AdaGuard generalizes to user-defined safety and compliance policies at runtime without requiring frequent model updates. A core innovation of our approach is the ability to dynamically infer the complexity of input-policy pairs, allowing the model to switch between high-speed black-box inference and explainable, reasoning-enabled moderation. This flexibility enables developers to balance stringent latency requirements with the need for actionable transparency. This adaptive capability allows AdaGuard to rival other guardrail and frontier models several times its size, while its auto-reasoning mode recovers the accuracy of always-on reasoning at a fraction of the latency
tldr: 论文提出 AdaGuard，一个自适应 LLM-as-a-Judge 护栏框架，通过动态策略执行和自适应推理预算分配，在运行时泛化到用户自定义的安全与合规策略。该框架可动态推断输入-策略对的复杂度，在高速黑盒推理与可解释推理模式间切换，以更低延迟达到接近常开推理模式的准确率。
